# Admin checklist (generated by the build)

Re-generated every time you run `npm run build`. Nothing below is shown publicly as if it were real.

## Information only you can provide

- [ ] Business email address (site.config.json > contact.email). Hidden on the site until set.
- [ ] Business phone number (contact.phone). Hidden until set.
- [ ] WhatsApp number in international format, e.g. +91XXXXXXXXXX (contact.whatsappNumber). The WhatsApp button is hidden until set.
- [ ] Registered office address (contact.address) and set contact.addressVerified to true. Hidden until both are done.
- [ ] Business hours (contact.hours), optional.
- [ ] CIN (registration.cin), optional but recommended for a private limited company.
- [ ] GSTIN (registration.gstin), if registered for GST.
- [ ] City whose courts have jurisdiction (legal.governingLawCity). The legal pages currently say "competent courts in India".
- [ ] Social media links (social.*), optional.
- [ ] Vercel environment variables for the enquiry form: RESEND_API_KEY, CONTACT_TO_EMAIL, CONTACT_FROM_EMAIL (see README.md). Without them the form shows a clear "unavailable" message and nothing is sent.

## Items to verify or confirm

- [ ] Hosting specifications not yet confirmed (shown publicly as "Confirmed on enquiry"): 24 values in content/hosting.json (storage, bandwidth, emailAccounts, ssl, backups, support, renewal, cancellation). Backup frequency in particular must be confirmed (an earlier version of the site said both daily and weekly).
- [ ] Training programme duration (content/training.json) is blank and therefore hidden.
- [ ] Training programme mode (content/training.json) is blank and therefore hidden.
- [ ] Training programme fee (content/training.json) is blank and therefore hidden.
- [ ] Training programme nextBatch (content/training.json) is blank and therefore hidden.
- [ ] No testimonials yet. The section is hidden until you add genuine reviews to content/testimonials.json (with the customer's permission).
- [ ] All portfolio items are labelled demonstration projects. Add real client work (with permission) to content/work.json when available.
- [ ] siteUrl is still the vercel.app address. When your own domain is connected, update siteUrl in site.config.json so canonical URLs, the sitemap and social previews use it.
- [ ] Legal pages are drafts. Have an Indian lawyer review the Privacy Policy, Terms and Refund Policy, then set legal.showDraftNotice to false.
- [ ] Email provider: the privacy policy names Resend as the email delivery provider. If you use another provider, change legal.emailProvider and the API code.
